profile.summary: BAVC Media is a nonprofit based in San Francisco. It provides media training, access to production technology, storytelling workshops, workforce development and audio-visual preservation services to people across the Bay Area, including youth programs.

review.notes: The agenda name 'Bay Area Video Coalition' (San Francisco) exactly matches the registered 501(c)(3) Bay Area Video Coalition Inc (EIN 94-2403876), and bavc.org lists youth media education, consistent with OUSD after-school contracts. All profile fields (legal name, EIN, address, phone, info@bavc.org, summary) were confirmed on ProPublica, bavc.org/about and bavc.org/contact; the candidate's 'Oakland Reel Stories site' signal was not confirmed on the About page, but it is not a profile field and identity does not depend on it.
